description: Pathogenic TWIST1 copy-number variants in ClinVar are large 7p imbalances, not gene-level deletions
code:
import requests, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

base="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"; H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
ids=requests.get(base+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":"TWIST1[gene]","retmax":3000,"retmode":"json"},
                 headers=H,timeout=90).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),300):
    d=requests.get(base+"esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","retmode":"json","id":",".join(ids[i:i+300])},
                   headers=H,timeout=120).json()
    recs+=[v for k,v in d.get("result",{}).items() if k!="uids"]; time.sleep(0.35)

TW_S,TW_E=19020991,19117636
rows=[]
for v in recs:
    cls=(v.get("germline_classification") or {}).get("description","") or ""
    vs=(v.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]; vt=vs.get("variant_type","")
    st=sp=np.nan
    for loc in vs.get("variation_loc",[]):
        if loc.get("assembly_name")=="GRCh38" and loc.get("start"):
            st=int(loc["start"]); sp=int(loc["stop"]); break
    rows.append(dict(cls=cls,vtype=vt,start=st,stop=sp))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df["plp"]=df.cls.isin({"Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"})
df["size"]=df.stop-df.start+1

cn=df[df.plp & df["size"].gt(1000)].copy()
cn["dir"]=np.where(cn.vtype.str.contains("gain|Duplication",case=False),"gain / duplication","loss / deletion")
cn["mb"]=cn["size"]/1e6
print(cn.groupby("dir").agg(n=("mb","size"),median_mb=("mb","median"),min_mb=("mb","min"),max_mb=("mb","max")).round(2).to_string())
print("\nAll encompass TWIST1 entirely:", bool(((cn.start<=TW_S)&(cn.stop>=TW_E)).all()))
print("Smallest CNV: %.2f Mb" % cn.mb.min(), " -> contains ~%d-fold the 96.6 kb TWIST1 locus" % (cn.mb.min()*1e6/96646))
print("CNVs >5 Mb: %d/%d (%.0f%%)" % ((cn.mb>5).sum(), len(cn), 100*(cn.mb>5).mean()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
for i,(d_,c) in enumerate([("loss / deletion","#b2182b"),("gain / duplication","#2166ac")]):
    s=cn[cn.dir==d_].mb.sort_values().values
    ax.scatter(s,np.full(len(s),i)+np.random.RandomState(0).uniform(-.12,.12,len(s)),c=c,s=60,alpha=.85,edgecolor="k",lw=.4)
ax.axvline(0.0966,ls="--",c="k",lw=1.2)
ax.text(0.105,1.45,"TWIST1 locus\n96.6 kb",fontsize=8,va="top")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["loss /\ndeletion","gain /\nduplication"])
ax.set_xlabel("CNV size (Mb, log scale)")
ax.set_title("Every pathogenic TWIST1 CNV in ClinVar is a large 7p imbalance\nmedian 18.3 Mb, none isolates the gene",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
counts=df[df.plp].vtype.value_counts()
ax.bar(range(len(counts)),counts.values,color=["#b2182b" if "single nucleotide" in i else "#8aa8c4" for i in counts.index],edgecolor="k",lw=.4)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(counts))); ax.set_xticklabels(counts.index,rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("P/LP ClinVar records"); ax.set_title("P/LP record types for TWIST1 (n=159)",fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(counts.values): ax.text(i,v+1,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
